readRules: Java, a server option: the option's field reached through ServerOptions.instance or ServerOptions.getInstance() (or a local variable holding one of them, inside the same method), the field reached with this. inside ServerOptions itself (its constructor, which only builds the public list, is left out), and a call getOption / getBoolean / getInteger / getFloat / getDouble / getOptionByName / putOption / putSaveOption / changeOption with the option's name written as text, on a ServerOptions receiver.

Java, a sandbox option: the option's field reached through SandboxOptions.instance or SandboxOptions.getInstance() (for a nested group, through its group field, such as lore or zombieConfig), through a local variable holding SandboxOptions or one of its groups inside the same method, or with this. inside SandboxOptions; and getOptionByName with the option's name written as text. A getOptionByName whose name is built at run time ("MultiplierConfig." + a skill) is kept as a computed read for every option the prefix can reach, and so is an option the world generator's Lua data names as "Sandbox.Name", which ProbaString looks up by that name.

A write is kept apart from a read: in Java a call to setValue, parse or setValueFromObject on the option, or putOption / putSaveOption / changeOption with its name; in Lua an assignment to SandboxVars.Name. The debug scenarios and the Last Stand challenges set many sandbox values this way.

Lua (vanilla media/lua, all three folders), a server option: getServerOptions():<getter>("Name") or ServerOptions.getInstance():<getter>("Name"). A sandbox option: SandboxVars.Name, SandboxVars.Group.Name, SandboxVars["Name"], and getSandboxOptions():getOptionByName("Name").
Not counted as reads: the declaration itself, the settings screens' lists of option names, the preset files, the translation files, and the generic loops that load, save, copy or send every option.

An option with no read site is searched once more for its name written as text anywhere else in Java or Lua; a hit there is listed as "named in" (the name appears, but no read of the value was recognised). An option with neither is marked "not read by the 42.21 code".
A capability: Capability.Name in Java or Lua, except the enum itself, the built-in role definitions in Roles#addStatic, and the command annotations (listed with each command instead).

commands.help: Save the current world
Broadcast a message to all connected players. Use: /servermsg "My Message"
Displays information on all connections
Use this command to add a new user to a whitelisted server. Use: /adduser "username" "password" -- password is optional
Use this command to add a SteamID to a list of allowed SteamIDs on server. Use: /addSteamID "steamid"
Use this command to remove a SteamID from a list of allowed SteamIDs on server. Use: /removeSteamID "steamid"
Save and quit the server
Sound a building alarm at the Admin's position. (Must be in a room)
Place a helicopter event on a random player
Add all the current users who are connected with a password to the whitelist, so their account is protected.
Kick a user. Add a -r "reason" to specify a reason for the kick. Use: /kickuser "username" -r "reason"
Teleport to a player. Once teleported, wait for the map to appear. Use /teleport "playername" or /teleport "player1" "player2". Example /teleport "rj" or /teleport "rj" "toUser"
Teleport a player to another player. Use /teleportplayer "player1" "player2". Example /teleportplayer "rj" "toUser"
Teleport to coordinates. Use /teleportto x,y,z. Example /teleportto 10000,11000,0
Release a safehouse. Use /releasesafehouse "title"
Starts raining on the server. Use /startrain "intensity", optional intensity is from 1 to 100
Stop raining on the server
Use /thunder "username", username is optional except from the server console
Place a gunshot sound on a random player
Reload server options (ServerOptions.ini) and send to clients

variants.argName: Ban User And IP And Supply Reason

commands.help: Ban a user. Add a -ip to also ban the IP. Add a -r "reason" to specify a reason for the ban. Use: /banuser "username" -ip -r "reason". For example: /banuser "rj" -ip -r "spawn kill"
Ban a SteamID. Use /banid SteamID
Ban IP. Use /banip IP
Unban a player. Use /unbanuser "username"
Unban a SteamID. Use /unbanid SteamID
Unban IP. Use /unbanip IP
Add a user connected with a password to the whitelist, so their account is protected. Use: /addusertowhitelist "username"
Adds player to a safehouse. Use /addtosafehouse "title" "username"
Removes player from a safehouse. Use /kickfromsafehouse "title" "username"
Remove a user from the whitelist. Use: /removeuserfromwhitelist "username"
Change a server option. Use: /changeoption optionName "newValue"
Show the list of current server options and values.
Make yourself invincible. Use: /godmode -value, ex /godmode -true (could be -false)
Make a player invincible. Use: /godmodeplayer "username" -value, ex /godmodeplayer "rj" -true (could be -false)
Block voice from user "username". Use /voiceban "username" -value. Example /voiceban "rj" -true (could be -false)
Makes a player pass through walls and structures. Toggles with no value. Use: /noclip "username" -value. Example /noclip "rj" -true (could be -false)
Make yourself invisible to zombies. Use: /invisible -value, ex /invisible -true (could be -false)
Make a player invisible to zombies. Use: /invisibleplayer "username" -value, ex /invisibleplayer "rj" -true (could be -false)
Help
List all connected players
Give an item to a player. If no username is given then you will receive the item yourself. Count is optional. Use: /additem "username" "module.item" count. Example: /additem "rj" Base.Axe 5
Remove items from yourself. Removes all items of type if count set to 0. Use: /removeitem "module.item" count. Example: /removeitem Base.Axe 5
Give XP to a player. Use /addxp "playername" perkname=xp -true. Example /addxp "rj" Woodwork=2 -true. The last argument is optional and is used to take xp multiplier into account
Spawn a vehicle. Use: /addvehicle "script" "user or x,y,z", ex /addvehicle "Base.VanAmbulance" "rj"

Spawn a horde near a player. Use : /createhorde count "username". Example /createhorde 150 "rj" Username is optional except from the server console. With no username the horde will be created around you
Reload a Lua script on the server. Use /reloadlua "filename"
Reload a Lua script on the server. Use /reloadlua "filename"
Set access level of a player. Current levels: Admin, Moderator, Overseer, GM, Observer. Use /setaccesslevel "username" "accesslevel". Example /setaccesslevel "rj" "moderator"
Set log level. Use /log %1 %2
Use /lightning "username", username is optional except from the server console
Stop weather on the server
Starts a storm on the server. Use /startstorm "duration", optional duration is in game hours
Indicates whether a mod has been updated. Writes answer to log file
Give a key to a player. If no username is given then you will receive the item yourself. Key name is optional. Use: /addkey "username" "keyId" "name". Example: /addkey "rj" "7295
Set the time multiplier on the server. Use /setTimeSpeed period. Example /setTimeSpeed 10
Use this command to change password for a user. Use: /setpassword "username" "newpassword"
Get server statistics. Use /stats help to get the details
Control full world generator. Use commands '/worldgen start', '/worldgen recheck', '/worldgen stop', and '/worldgen status'. Use
Removes all shared in-game map symbols for a specific user. Use /removemapsymbolsforuser "username"

playerCommands.name: roll
playerCommands.help: If you have dice, you can roll a random number - up to 100. Use: /roll 6

playerCommands.name: card
playerCommands.help: If you have a card deck, you can draw a random card. Use: /card

playerCommands.name: safehouse
playerCommands.help: Release a safehouse you own. Use /releasesafehouse

roles.name: observer
roles.description: Can use teleport, god mode, go inside safehouse. But he can't add xp, items and make another change.

roles.name: gm
roles.description: Can use teleport, god mode, add xp, items and make another change.

roles.name: moderator
roles.description: Can make all except edit roles, reload lua files, change server options.

capabilities.name: LoginOnServer
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to login to server.

capabilities.name: PriorityLogin
capabilities.tooltip: Player get preferential treatment when logging into a full server. The player can also create an unlimited number of accounts.

capabilities.name: CantBeKickedIfTooLaggy
capabilities.tooltip: Player won't be kicked for lag issues.

capabilities.name: ToggleGodModHimself
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to switch god mode on and off. Use /godmod or /godmode console command.

capabilities.name: ToggleInvisibleHimself
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to toggle their visibility to others. Use /invisible console command.

capabilities.name: ToggleInvincibleHimself
capabilities.tooltip: Player can make themselves invulnerable to damage. Use option in Admin Powers window.

capabilities.name: ToggleNoclipHimself
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to walk through walls. Option can be enabled by /noclip console command.

capabilities.name: SeePlayersConnected
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to a list of all currently connected players and active connections. Use /players and / connections console commands.

capabilities.name: TeleportToPlayer
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to instantly teleport to the location of another player. Use context menu option in MiniScoreboard UI or button in Player List window.

capabilities.name: TeleportToCoordinates
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to teleport to any specific coordinates on the map. Use context menu option in MiniScoreboard UI or button in Player List window.

capabilities.name: SeePublicServerOptions
capabilities.tooltip: Player can view the server options in Admin Panel.

capabilities.name: CanOpenLockedDoors
capabilities.tooltip: Player can open normally inaccessible doors.

capabilities.name: CanGoInsideSafehouses
capabilities.tooltip: Player have access to safehouses that are typically locked.

capabilities.name: CanAlwaysJoinServer
capabilities.tooltip: Player can always join a server, even if it's full.

capabilities.name: SeesInvisiblePlayers
capabilities.tooltip: Player can see other players who are invisible.

capabilities.name: CanSeeMessageForAdmin
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to receive messages sent by players for administrators.

capabilities.name: PVPLogTool
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use PVPLogTool in the Admin panel.

capabilities.name: CanSeePlayersStats
capabilities.tooltip: Player can see the statistics and information of other players. Use Player Stats button in Admin Panel.

capabilities.name: CantBeKickedByAnticheat
capabilities.tooltip: Player will not be kicked by the anti-cheat system.

capabilities.name: CantBeKickedByUser
capabilities.tooltip: Player can't be kicked by other users.

capabilities.name: CantBeBannedByAnticheat
capabilities.tooltip: Player will not be banned by the anti-cheat system.

capabilities.name: CantBeBannedByUser
capabilities.tooltip: Player can't be banned by other users.

capabilities.name: SeeWorldMap
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to see other players on the world map.

capabilities.name: CanMedicalCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use MedicalCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UIManagerProcessCommands
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to execute console commands.

capabilities.name: ToggleGodModEveryone
capabilities.tooltip: Player can toggle god mode for all players on the server.

capabilities.name: ToggleInvisibleEveryone
capabilities.tooltip: Player can make other players invisible. Use /invisible command or context menu in MiniScoreboard window.

capabilities.name: ToggleNoclipEveryone
capabilities.tooltip: Player can enable noclip functionality for everyone on the server. Use /noclip console command.

capabilities.name: TeleportPlayerToAnotherPlayer
capabilities.tooltip: Allows the player to teleport any player to any location. Use context menu option in users list UI or button in players list.

capabilities.name: MakeEventsAlarmGunshot
capabilities.tooltip: Allows the player to trigger in-game sound events. Use commands /alarm, /gunshot, /thunder, and /chopper.

capabilities.name: StartStopRain
capabilities.tooltip: Allows the player to start or stop raining events. Use command /startrain, /startstorm, /stoprain, /stopweather, and /thunder.

capabilities.name: AddItem
capabilities.tooltip: Allows the player to add an item to their inventory or other players inventory. Use command /additem and /addkey or items list UI.

capabilities.name: AddXP
capabilities.tooltip: Allows the player to add experience points to themselves or other players. Use command /addxp.

capabilities.name: SeeNetworkUsers
capabilities.tooltip: Player can see all connected network users information

capabilities.name: CreateHorde
capabilities.tooltip: Player can spawn hordes of zombies at a desired location. Use /createhorde and /createhorde2 console commands.

capabilities.name: CreateStory
capabilities.tooltip: Player can create custom storylines or scenarios within the game. Use Randomized Zone Story and Randomized Road Story context menu options.

capabilities.name: KickUser
capabilities.tooltip: Player can kick other players from the server. Use /kick or /kickuser console commands.

capabilities.name: DisplayServerMessage
capabilities.tooltip: Player can broadcast messages to all players on the server. Use /servermsg console command.

capabilities.name: CanModifyPlayerStatsInThePlayerStatsUI
capabilities.tooltip: Player can modify player stats. Use Player Stats button in the Admin Panel.

capabilities.name: CanModifyBodyStats
capabilities.tooltip: Player can modify player body stats. Use Body section from General Debuggers in the Debug Menu panel.

capabilities.name: AdminChat
capabilities.tooltip: Player have access to a separate chat channel for administrators.

capabilities.name: HideFromSteamUserList
capabilities.tooltip: Player can make themselves invisible from other players in the Users List window on Steam servers.

capabilities.name: ToggleWriteRoleNameAbove
capabilities.tooltip: Player role will be displaying above him.

capabilities.name: BanUnbanUser
capabilities.tooltip: Player have the ability to ban and unban users from the server. Use commands /banuser, /unbanuser, /banid and /unbanid.

capabilities.name: EditMapSymbols
capabilities.tooltip: Player have the ability to modify shared map symbols. Use commands /removemapsymbolsforuser.

capabilities.name: ManipulateWhitelist
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to add or remove players from the whitelist. Use commands /setpassword, /adduser, /addusertowhitelist, /addalltowhitelist and /removeuserfromwhitelist.

capabilities.name: ChangeAccessLevel
capabilities.tooltip: Player can change the access level of other players on the server. Use command /setaccesslevel.

capabilities.name: CanSetupSafehouses
capabilities.tooltip: Player can create and configure safe houses within the game world. Use context menu and commands /addtosafehouse, /kickfromsafehouse and /releasesafehouse.

capabilities.name: CanSetupNonPVPZone
capabilities.tooltip: Player can establish areas on the map where PvP combat is disabled. Use Non PVP Zone button in the Admin Panel.

capabilities.name: FactionCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to manage factions. Use button in the Admin Panel.

capabilities.name: AnswerTickets
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to see and manage the list of in-game tickets raised by other players. Use See Tickets button in the Admin panel.

capabilities.name: RolesRead
capabilities.tooltip: Player can view the roles and permissions assigned to other players on the server. Use Roles List button in the Admin Panel.

capabilities.name: ToggleUnlimitedEndurance
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use UnlimitedEnduranceCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: ToggleUnlimitedCarry
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use UnlimitedCarryCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseMovablesCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use MovablesCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseFastMoveCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use FastMoveCheat, which is enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseBuildCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use BuildCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseFarmingCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use FarmingCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseFishingCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use FishingCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseHealthCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use HealthCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseMechanicsCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use MechanicsCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseTimedActionInstantCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use TimedActionInstantCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: UseZombieDontAttackCheat
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use UseZombieDontAttackCheat, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: GeneralCheats
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use /roll and /card console commands. Also allows to remove vehicles.

capabilities.name: ModifyNetworkUsers
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to add, kick, ban, unban users using console commands.

capabilities.name: EditItem
capabilities.tooltip: Player can change properties or attributes of items in the game world. Use inventory context menu option.

capabilities.name: GetSteamScoreboard
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use mini scoreboard in Admin panel.

capabilities.name: GetStatistic
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to access detailed server, connections and packets statistics. Use Packet Counts and Show Statistics buttons in Admin panel.

capabilities.name: SandboxOptions
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to change sandbox options. Use Sandbox Options button in Admin panel.

capabilities.name: ReadUserLog
capabilities.tooltip: Player can view the logs of other players on the server. Use context menu in Users List window.

capabilities.name: AddUserlog
capabilities.tooltip: Player can add their own entries to logs of other players on the server. Use context menu in Users List window.

capabilities.name: WorkWithUserlog
capabilities.tooltip: Player can remove entries from logs of other players on the server. Use context menu in Users List window.

capabilities.name: ClimateManager
capabilities.tooltip: Player can control and alter environmental factors like the weather on the server. Use Climate Control button in Admin Panel.

capabilities.name: InspectPlayerInventory
capabilities.tooltip: Player can view the inventory contents of any other player on the server.

capabilities.name: AnimalCheats
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use AnimalCheats, which are enabled in the AdminPowers window.

capabilities.name: DebugConsole
capabilities.tooltip: Player have access to a console command interface for debugging and testing purposes. Use commands /log and /clear.

capabilities.name: PopmanManage
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to spawn and remove zombies. Use Zombie Population button in Debug panel.

capabilities.name: ManipulateVehicle
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to spawn vehicles in the game world. Use /addvehicle console command.

capabilities.name: ManipulateMods
capabilities.tooltip: Player can update installed mods within the game. Use /checkModsNeedUpdate command.

capabilities.name: ManipulateZombie
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to remove zombies by console command or set them don't attack player. Use option in Admin Powers window.

capabilities.name: CanSeeAll
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to see other players regardless of obstacles. Use option in Admin Powers window.

capabilities.name: CanHearAll
capabilities.tooltip: Player can hear all voice conversations occurring on the server. Use option in Admin Powers window.

capabilities.name: UseBrushToolManager
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to use BrushToolManager, which is enabled in the AdminPowers window, and can be activated by button in map context menu.

capabilities.name: SaveWorld
capabilities.tooltip: Player can save the current state of the game world, preserving changes and progress.

capabilities.name: QuitWorld
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to immediately close server. Use /quit console command.

capabilities.name: ChangeAndReloadServerOptions
capabilities.tooltip: Player can modify and reload server options on-the-fly. Use commands /changeoption and /reloadoptions.

capabilities.name: ReloadLuaFiles
capabilities.tooltip: Player can reload Lua scripts used by the game server. Use /reloadlua command.

capabilities.name: BypassLuaChecksum
capabilities.tooltip: Checksum verification for Lua files is disabled for player, allowing for potentially unauthorized modifications.

capabilities.name: RolesWrite
capabilities.tooltip: Allows player to modify and assign roles and permissions to other players on the server. Use Roles List button in the Admin Panel.

capabilities.name: ConnectWithDebug
capabilities.tooltip: Player have access to a debugging connection with specific permissions. Use commands /debugplayer and /setTimeSpeed.
